Prebiotics in Kenya

Probiotics need the right food to survive and thrive, and that is precisely what prebiotic supplements provide. By feeding the beneficial bacteria already living in your gut, prebiotics amplify the results you get from probiotic use, improve regularity, reduce gut inflammation, and help create an environment where harmful bacteria struggle to gain a foothold. Regular prebiotic use is linked to better stool consistency, less bloating, and a calmer digestive system overall. Now Foods and Jarrow Formulas offer well-researched prebiotic fibres including inulin and FOS, while Garden of Life combines prebiotics and probiotics in convenient daily formulas. Also explore probiotics and digestive enzymes to build a complete gut health routine, or browse all Probiotics & Gut Health products. Order via WhatsApp for same-day delivery in Nairobi.
